Budget Plan for Advanced Hiking

Initial Costs:
- High-quality hiking boots: $150 - $250
- Durable backpack (50-70L): $150 - $300
- Lightweight tent (2-person): $200 - $400
- Total Initial Investment: $500 - $950

Ongoing Costs:
- Replacement of worn gear (boots every 2-3 years): ~$100/year
- Trail permits and park fees: $20 - $50 per trip
- Food and supplies for multi-day treks: $10 - $15 per day
- Maintenance (gear cleaning, repairs): $50/year
- Estimated Annual Ongoing Cost: $150 - $300 (excluding food/travel)

The fastest land animal in the world is the cheetah.
